zh.widget.goal-progress.name: 目标进度
zh.widget.goal-progress.desc: 目标的生命周期阶段（进行中 / 已暂停 / 受阻 / 已完成 / 无目标），下面三行是目标原文、轮次 / 上限（还没跑过轮次时印「尚未开始」，绝不印 0 / 256）、最近变更；没有目标时保持安静空态，不会从组件栏消失
zh.widget.goal-progress.simToggle: 切换 无目标 / 进行中 / 刚创建 / 受阻 / 已完成 预览
zh.card.goal-progress.title: 目标进度

en.widget.goal-progress.name: Goal Progress
en.widget.goal-progress.desc: The goal's lifecycle phase (active / paused / blocked / complete / no goal), then three rows: the objective, rounds / max (a goal that has not run a round says "Not started" — never 0 / 256) and the last change; with no goal the card stays as a quiet empty state instead of disappearing
en.widget.goal-progress.simToggle: Cycle no-goal / active / just-created / blocked / complete
en.card.goal-progress.title: Goal Progress
